drums.tags: Stomp and clap folk rock. The track features heavy, resonant foot stomps on beats 1 and 3, paired with crisp hand claps on beats 2 and 4. An acoustic guitar plays a driving, percussive strumming pattern in 4/4 time at 115 BPM. The arrangement builds with a bright, rhythmic tambourine and a group of male vocalists performing wordless, rhythmic chanting. The key is G major. The production is dry with minimal reverb, emphasizing the organic, acoustic textures of the percussion and strings.
drums.prompt:
[Intro]
[heavy foot stomps on beats 1 and 3]
[hand claps on beats 2 and 4]
[acoustic guitar enters with percussive strumming]

[Verse 1]
[group male vocals, rhythmic chanting]
Hey! [tambourine enters]
Hey!
Hey!
Hey!

[Chorus]
[full acoustic ensemble]
Ho! [guitar accent]
Ho!
Ho!
Ho!

[Outro]
[rhythm continues]
[final stomp and clap unison hit]
[guitar ring out to silence]

bass.tags: Industrial techno with heavy distortion and mechanical textures. A distorted, resonant kick drum provides a rhythmic pulse at 130 BPM in 4/4 time. A metallic, percussive synth sequence with high-pass filtering and short decay creates a rhythmic counterpoint. Low-frequency drone pads with slow modulation provide a dark harmonic layer. Industrial sound effects, including metallic clangs and white noise bursts with heavy reverb, are interspersed throughout. The track features a minimalist arrangement with gradual filter sweeps and bit-crushing effects on the percussion. The key is C minor.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[distorted kick drum pulse, low-frequency drone]

[Section A]
[metallic percussive synth sequence enters]
[high-pass filter sweep on percussion]

[Section B]
[white noise bursts with heavy reverb]
[bit-crushed industrial sound effects]
[resonant filter modulation on the kick drum]
